description: Measures GPU memory bandwidth in three directions: Host-to-Device (H2D), Device-to-Host (D2H), and Device-to-Device (D2D) using hipMemcpy with pinned host memory. Reports bandwidth in GB/s.

scaling_param.name: buffer_size_mb
scaling_param.description: Transfer buffer size in MiB; controls the total data volume per transfer

non_scaling_params.name: num_iterations
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed transfer repetitions for stable averaging

non_scaling_params.name: use_pinned_memory
non_scaling_params.description: Whether to use pinned (page-locked) host memory for transfers
